# VitalScale Digital

> Calm, nurse-led help for NDIS providers in Australia: social media growth, NDIS policy writing for the new rules, safe AI for repetitive admin, and credible websites. Founded by Ajay Singh, a Registered Nurse. Plain English, fixed prices, and no promises of registration or audit outcomes.

## Key facts

- Founded and run by Ajay Singh, a Registered Nurse. Clients deal with Ajay directly, from the first review to the finished work.
- Works with NDIS providers across Australia.
- Every job has a fixed price, with what's included and what isn't written down before work starts.
- Never promises NDIS registration or audit results, and doesn't act as an auditor: audits must be done by an approved quality auditor.
- Safe AI rules: only Australian-hosted tools that don't train on client data, no participant information in public chatbots, and staff check and sign off everything AI drafts. VitalScale never holds participants' information.
- The NDIS changes on the home page are checked against official NDIS sources every Monday.
- Contact: a free 20-minute review, booked through the form at https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/#book.
- Phone and WhatsApp: 0406 970 615 (+61 406 970 615). WhatsApp chats are answered any time.

## Services

- [Social media growth](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/social): posts planned, written, designed and scheduled for NDIS providers, reported on enquiries rather than likes.
- [Policy writing](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/policies): NDIS policies rewritten for the new changes, with an audit-ready evidence system that shows each policy is actually happening.
- [Safe AI](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/ai): AI set up around existing admin, using Australian-hosted tools that don't train on your data, with staff always checking and deciding.
- [Websites](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/websites): credible, fast, accessible websites that tell families and support coordinators what a provider does and how to refer.
